title: Yellowed Sweet Russian Saskatoon Berry Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring saskatoon berries and pillowy dumplings, perfect for a midnight craving. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the saskatoon berries.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls into a greased Dutch oven.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the dumplings are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
